[3]15SDQ self SDQ parents SDQ teacher75%Significantly more peer problems in the CI-group than in the comparison group of normally hearing peers. Apart from that there was no significant difference between CI- and normal hearing group. Pupils of schools for persons with hearing loss and sign language competent persons showed more problems. The better the speech perception outcomes and reading-speech comprehension, the less are the mental health problems.
